# @loom/utils

> Small cross-platform utilities shared by apps and packages.

## Start here
- [Package exports](./package.json)
- [Identifiers](./src/identifiers.ts)
- [Retry helpers](./src/retry.ts)
- [Public entry](./src/index.ts)

## Rules for agents
- Add only utilities used by more than one package or app; feature-specific behavior belongs with its feature.
- Keep implementations portable across Bun, browsers, and Cloudflare Workers. Do not add Node-only imports.
- Do not add a dependency when the Web Platform or Bun already provides the needed behavior.
- Prefer focused subpath imports over the root entry when only one helper is needed.
